items.html: And however, the brain that goes out from the Hochma has spreading only up to the brain, and its spreading is through the hairs of the upper head, for through it it spreads into the thirty-two paths. And this is because the light passes from the upper hairs, through the lower hairs, to the brain of ZA. And as we say in the Idra Rabba: 'and it shines and flows in those hairs, to the hairs of ZA, and from this his brain is corrected, and then that brain flows into the thirty-two paths.' And this indicates the extreme smallness of the light, because of the abundance of its concealment.
